clips.said: They write code, ship releases, move data. And they hold your keys.
One night, one of them reaches for something it shouldn't.
Wagent checks every action before it runs. This one, it stops.
Then comes the part no single agent can do alone. The lesson travels.
Through Flower, the block becomes a rule, and every agent learns it. On any model. On any machine.
Each agent tests the rule on its own work first, so a bad rule never spreads.
Only the rule moves. Your code and your data never leave home.
When something needs a human, you know right away.
Wagent. A warden for your AI agents.
